name: cms.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms.scss — MANIFEST for the CMS/admin theme (dark developer-console
//  aesthetic). Split by surface into cms/ partials (imported below):
//    _tokens           :host/:root token publication + document base
//    _login            admin login card
//    _header           CMS header + quick cloud/AI admin bar
//    _tabs             tab navigation + main content container
//    _forms            cards, field groups, inputs, buttons
//    _toast            notification toast + cmsFadeIn
//    _editors          shared editor layout helpers + gravatar editor
//    _lists            paragraph/channel/mention/section/media list editors,
//                      cover layout, key/value list, checkbox
//    _portfolio        portfolio list editor rows
//    _media-converter  localhost media converter (dropzone, list, progress)
//    _deploy           Deploy Info report table + score pills
//  Loaded only by the CMS bundle — never by the public site.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../core/sass/base/variables';

@import 'cms/tokens';
@import 'cms/login';
@import 'cms/header';
@import 'cms/tabs';
@import 'cms/forms';
@import 'cms/toast';
@import 'cms/editors';
@import 'cms/lists';
@import 'cms/portfolio';
@import 'cms/media-converter';
@import 'cms/deploy';
